Package org.apache.beam.runners.spark.translation

Class SparkDatasetTranslationContext

java.lang.Object
org.apache.beam.runners.spark.translation.SparkTranslationContext
org.apache.beam.runners.spark.translation.SparkDatasetTranslationContext
public class SparkDatasetTranslationContext extends SparkTranslationContext
Translation context of the Dataset-based portable backend. Keeps one Dataset per translated PCollection and evaluates the ones no transform consumed in computeOutputs().
